plants.name: Prunus × yedoensis
plants.description: Clouds of blush-white blossoms cover bare branches before the leaves appear. Petals drift down like confetti in spring breezes, and whole parks turn into pale pink tunnels.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late March to mid-April in Washington, D.C., usually peaking in the first week or two of April
plants.location: Washington, D.C., USA, around the Tidal Basin, and in Japan's Kansai and Kanto regions in early April
plants.funFact: Cherry blossom viewing in Japan, called hanami, has been celebrated for more than a thousand years. The trees' brief bloom is a symbol of the fleeting nature of life.

plants.name: Tulipa gesneriana
plants.description: Cup-shaped blooms stand on sturdy stems in a wide range of bright colors. They fill spring beds and the famous bulb fields with bold stripes of color.
plants.bloomingSeason: Early April to early May in the Netherlands, with mid-April typically the start of peak bloom in the bulb fields
plants.location: The Netherlands, including the bulb region near Lisse, and temperate gardens across Europe and North America
plants.funFact: In the 1630s, tulip bulbs were so prized in the Dutch Republic that single bulbs sold for more than a skilled craftsman earned in a year. The episode is known as tulip mania.

plants.name: Colchicum autumnale
plants.description: This is a South African-hemisphere autumn bloomer, so it is not included in this list.
